layout_method: Keep the accepted riverfront single-rider person1/rig relationship; enumerate 4 forward gaps x 4 lateral offsets x 2 speed differences, seeded order and bounded cell jitter. Person2 uses its own verified asset, origin and fixed height.

hard_gates.target_dual_edge: same tick both cameras >=8 R138 inside and >=5 outside, >=8 common; >=16/31 ticks, >=0.5 s consecutive
hard_gates.road_and_person_separation: existing per-person road/body-cloth envelope and pairwise 0.1m envelope clearance/0.9m root distance
hard_gates.ROI: per-person conservative full-square union including exact active groom; <=7000000 pixels per camera; full ERP raster and nonperiodic seam support
